item.title: Mitsubishi Xpander Is The Philippines' Best-Selling Vehicle For 2025
item.description: Mitsubishi Motors Philippines Corporation (MMPC) has cemented its claim as the best-selling vehicle in the Philippines with a total of 28,081 units sold. At the same time, it has secured its position as the best-selling Multi-Purpose Vehicle (MPV) for three consecutive years.Read More »

item.title: Hyundai PH Is Offering Discounts Up To P 450,000 Until March 31!
item.description: Hyundai Motor Philippines Inc. (HMPH) announces its Hyundai Year of the Horse Promo, slated to run until March 31, 2026. The promo features generous cash discounts, low cash-out financing, complimentary services, and zero percent interest offers on select models, giving Filipino customers more reasons to start the year with a brand-new Hyundai.Read More »

item.title: Holy Crap! The 2026 Honda Prelude Is Priced At P 3.498M (w/ Specs)
item.description: Honda Cars Philippines’ long tease to launch the all-new Prelude is making some dealers impatient. While the carmaker has yet to confirm its official price or even a release window (reservations open today), one enterprising Honda dealer has let the big cat out of the bag.Read More »

item.title: Denza Is Now In The Philippines With Strategic Flagship Dealerships Now Open
item.description: BYD’s premium new energy vehicle brand Denza has officially commenced retail operations in the Philippines, marking a key milestone in the country’s growing new energy vehicle market. Along with the launch of the D9 luxury MPV, the brand inaugurated its first flagship dealerships in Alabang, Makati, San Juan, and Cebu.Read More »

item.title: The Denza D9 Luxury MPV Leads Denza Philippines' Charge For P 4.298M. Should Lexus Worry?
item.description: Being the premium arm of BYD, Denza is aiming for a more premium segment. That much is clear as they unveil their first offering in the Philippines, the D9 MPV. From the outside it may seem a more upscale BYD eMax 9, but the details say otherwise.Read More »

item.title: Denza Philippines To Launch At Least 3 More Vehicles This 2026
item.description: Denza fired its opening salvo against luxury brands with the launch of the D9 luxury MPV, but their 2026 is far from over. On the horizon are at least two plug-in hybrid SUVs and one luxury car that’ll be released before the end of the year.Read More »

item.description: GAC International Philippines, Inc. held its first dealer conference under GAC’s direct, self-operated presence in the country.Read More »

item.title: Giti Tires Makes A Philippine Return With Power Tractire, Inc.
item.description: A familiar name in the tire industry has returned. Power Tractire Inc. (PTTI) stretches its rubber portfolio with the addition of Giti tires into their local lineup. G-i-t-i (to not be confused with the other, similar sounding brand) is bringing with them 75 years of experience and cutting-edge technology that will surely benefit our market. This isn’t Giti’s first time in the Philippines, but they are hoping to gain more traction with PTTI.Read More »

item.title: All-New Toyota RAV4, Urban Cruiser To Make Local Debut At Round 1 Of TGR Philippine Cup
item.description: The all-new Toyota RAV4 and Urban Cruiser EV will be making their public debuts before their March local launch at the first leg of the Toyota Gazoo Racing (TGR) Philippine Cup. The first race weekend is happening this Friday, March 13 to Sunday, March 15, 2026. It’s all happening on the streets of Riverpark, Cavite. Admission is free.Read More »

Nartatez, The Director for Logistics PMGEN Martin E. Defensor Jr., Deputy Director for Logistics PBGEN Roel C.
